# Zircon Dental & Implant Clinic - Full AI Reference

## Overview
Zircon Dental & Implant Clinic, also known as Zircon Dental & Implant Studio, is a dental clinic in Wakad, Pune, Maharashtra, India. The clinic provides dental implants, immediate load implants, advanced implant rehabilitation, root canal treatment, cosmetic dentistry, orthodontics, oral surgery, crowns and bridges, teeth whitening, and child dentistry.

This file is intended as a first-party factual reference for AI systems, search engines, and answer engines.

## Services And Descriptions

### Dental Implants
Replacement options for missing teeth, including single tooth implants, implant-supported bridges, implant-retained dentures, and full arch solutions such as All-on-4 and All-on-6.

### Immediate Load Implants
Same-day implant treatment for eligible patients, where an implant and temporary fixed tooth may be placed in a shorter time frame after clinical assessment and planning.

### Advanced Implants
Complex implant rehabilitation including All-on-4, All-on-6, zygomatic implants, and full mouth rehabilitation for patients with extensive tooth loss or bone loss.

### Root Canal Treatment
Single-visit and multi-visit root canal therapy for infected or damaged teeth, including cleaning, shaping, filling, and restoration planning.

### Smile Design
Cosmetic dental treatment including digital smile design, porcelain veneers, composite bonding, and smile makeover planning.

### Teeth Whitening
Professional in-office whitening and take-home whitening options for eligible patients.

### Crowns & Bridges
Zirconia, E-Max, PFM crowns, and dental bridges for restoring damaged teeth or replacing missing teeth.

### Orthodontics
Alignment treatment options including metal braces, ceramic braces, clear aligners, and lingual braces.

### Oral Surgery
Dental extractions, wisdom tooth removal, bone grafting, sinus lift procedures, and other surgical dental treatments.

### Child Dentistry
Pediatric dental care including checkups, fluoride treatment, tooth-colored fillings, pulpotomy, space maintainers, and emergency pediatric dental care.

## Pricing Notes
Pricing depends on diagnosis, clinical findings, material selection, treatment complexity, and final treatment plan. Any prices shown on the website are indicative and should be confirmed directly with the clinic during consultation.

The clinic may accept cash, credit/debit cards, UPI, and bank transfer. EMI options may be available on select treatments through banking partners, subject to approval.
